meta.verdict_plain: Failed: 102% of homes dark at the worst hour (hour 322)
meta.cause_summary: h82: Sweetwater below -5 C for 12 h (low -7 C) -> h84: wind turbines iced or too cold: 26% of wind fleet stopped, rising to 76% of wind fleet stopped by h169 -> h92: 1.2 GW of units failed to start in the cold -> h109: 2 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 11 h (low -10 C)), rising to 11 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 86 h (low -18 C)) by h184 -> h148: gas wells freezing (basin temp -3 C): production -10%, rising to production -25% by h181 -> h167: demand surge to 62,008 MW -> h167: reserves below 2,300 MW (871 MW) -> h167: rotating outages begin (660 MW) -> h168: under-frequency relays shed 5% at 59.3 Hz -> h171: shedding cut power to gas facilities: -0.5 GW gas fuel -> h175: 4 GW of gas plants without fuel, rising to 20 GW of gas plants without fuel by h285 -> survived with rotating outages (peak 35,000 MW)
